editingpresence-anonymous-count:
Used in a list of editor names to stand for logged out editors.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of anonymous editors
editingpresence-page-page-count:
Same as {{msg-mw|editingpresence-page-page-named}} but used when names are hidden.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of other editors
editingpresence-page-page-named:
Notice shown to a user editing the whole page. Other users are editing the whole page too.

Parameters:
* $1 - list of names, for example "Alice, Bob and 2 anonymous users"
* $2 - number of other editors, for PLURAL
editingpresence-page-section-count:
Same as {{msg-mw|editingpresence-page-section-named}} but used when names are hidden.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of other editors
editingpresence-page-section-named:
Notice shown to a user editing the whole page. Other users are editing a section of the page.

Parameters:
* $1 - list of names
* $2 - number of other editors, for PLURAL
editingpresence-section-page-count:
Same as {{msg-mw|editingpresence-section-page-named}} but used when names are hidden.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of other editors
editingpresence-section-page-named:
Notice shown to a user editing a single section. Other users are editing the whole page.

Parameters:
* $1 - list of names
* $2 - number of other editors, for PLURAL
editingpresence-section-section-count:
Same as {{msg-mw|editingpresence-section-section-named}} but used when names are hidden.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of other editors
editingpresence-section-section-named:
Notice shown to a user editing a single section. Other users are editing the same section.

Parameters:
* $1 - list of names
* $2 - number of other editors, for PLURAL
